entities.summary: Nikita Sergeevich Scherbak is a Russian professional ice hockey player for EC VSV of the ICE Hockey League. He was selected in the first round, 26th overall, by the Montreal Canadiens in the 2014 NHL Entry Draft. Scherbak has also previously played for the Los Angeles Kings.
